title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
abstract_first: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders.
fig_caption: Conceptual overview of VETR.  VETR refines scenes through execution-grounded evidence, bridging a scene program, its execution trace, and the realized 3D scene.…
